observations: The documentation explicitly identifies three distinct stakeholder groups with specific functional intentions: Researchers (converting DNA to protein, predicting impacts), Clinicians (accessing mutation frequencies, clinical actionability for patient care), and Bioinformaticians (high-throughput analysis, gene functions, variant effects).
Current HLG [1] adequately covers the Researchers' intention to convert DNA changes to protein changes and predict functional impacts for high-throughput analysis.
Current HLG [2] adequately covers the Clinicians' intention to access mutation frequencies and clinical actionability to improve patient care.
Current HLG [3] adequately covers the Bioinformaticians' intention to conduct high-throughput analysis and access gene function/variant effect data.

The core system goal of 'consolidating information from various databases' is a means to achieve the above stakeholder goals rather than a distinct autonomous WHY-level intention for a separate actor; it is implicitly covered by the provision of comprehensive insights/data in the existing HLGs.
No other distinct autonomous functional WHY-level intentions are explicitly or unambiguously supported by the documentation that are not already represented by the current HLG set.
